purpose: Deterministic meal swap and fallback configuration. Templates define structure; swap groups define allowed replacements; solver adjusts grams. Avoids random macro-role combinations.

highLevelPolicy.corePrinciple: Never generate meals by macro_role alone.
normalGenerationOrder: if no exact fit, try same-family same-slot swaps
return approximate meal if safe and coherent
fail only if no coherent family candidate exists
userSwapOrder: same family slotGroups for that slot
same family alternative group with explicit permission
highLevelPolicy.llmUsageRecommendation: Do not use an LLM at runtime for core meal validity. Use LLM offline only to propose new templates/groups, then validate into this deterministic file.

hardRejectRules.message: Do not replace food with random same macro_role item.
Sauces/mustard/soy sauce cannot be protein/carb/fat core items.
Fruit cannot replace rice/pasta/potatoes in meat plates.
Quinoa only belongs in grain_bowl or explicit quinoa templates.
Non-starchy vegetables are side items, not main macro fillers.
Nuts/peanut butter are fats/snacks, not lunch/dinner primary protein swaps.
Avocado is fat/side, not rice/bread/pasta replacement.
Use oils for lunch/dinner unless a template explicitly uses butter.

candidateFiltersMustPass: food is allowed by diet type
food does not contain user allergy
mealType is compatible, unless template explicitly permits it
candidate group is allowed by family slot
serving after solve is between minServingG and maxServingG or allowed relaxation

portionRelaxationPolicy.secondPass: allow up to 10% above maxServingG for normal foods, never for condiments/oils/nuts

templateFieldsToAdd.family: one key from mealFamilies, e.g. rice_plate
templateFieldsToAdd.components[].swapGroup: one key from swapGroups, e.g. protein.main.animal.lean
templateFieldsToAdd.components[].slot: primary_protein | main_carb | fat | vegetable_side | condiment | fruit_carb | legume_base | standalone

integrationInstructions.templateSelectionFix: If no exact template solves, do not generate random foods. Try same-family swaps and return best approximate coherent meal. Only fail if no coherent family candidate exists.
integrationInstructions.userSwapFix: For a clicked component, find its swapGroup and family slot. Suggest candidates only from that group/slot, then run portion solver.
integrationInstructions.migrationHint: Use templateInferenceRules plus foodDefaultSwapGroupById to auto-fill family/swapGroup for existing templates; then manually review low-confidence templates.

protein.main.animal.lean.intent: Lean animal proteins for normal lunch/dinner plates. Chicken can swap with shrimp, lean beef, tuna, tilapia, turkey here.
protein.main.animal.lean.notes: Best default group for fast user swaps such as chicken → shrimp or chicken → lean beef.

protein.main.animal.rich.intent: Higher-fat animal proteins. Use when the original protein is rich/fatty or when targets need more fat.
protein.main.animal.rich.notes: Do not mix with lean group unless solver needs calories/fat and family permits.

protein.breakfast.dairy.notes: Allowed for breakfast/snack; do not use as lunch/dinner primary unless template explicitly has dairy main.

protein.supplement.powder.intent: Protein powders. Only for breakfast/snack/shake style families.

protein.snack.bar.notes: Do not insert into full lunch/dinner meals.

plant.legume.bowl_base.intent: Legumes as the base of vegan/vegetarian bowls, not random carb filler for meat plates.

plant.nut.peanut_snack.notes: Do not use peanuts as a chicken/meat replacement in lunch/dinner.

carb.classic_starch.intent: Classic plate starches. Quinoa intentionally excluded to avoid quinoa appearing in every normal plate.

carb.grain_bowl.intent: Grain bowl carbs. Quinoa lives here, not in classic plate fallback.
carb.grain_bowl.notes: Use only for grain_bowl family or if template explicitly has quinoa.

side.vegetable.salad.intent: Raw salad vegetable side, not a main carb source.
side.vegetable.salad.notes: Never use as main macro filler.

side.vegetable.cooked.notes: Never use as main macro filler.

side.vegetable.all.notes: Side only, unless a template explicitly makes it primary.

fat.butter.spread.intent: Butter as spread, mainly breakfast/bread families.
fat.butter.spread.notes: Do not use as default fat for every lunch/dinner.

fat.avocado.intent: Avocado as fat/side, not as main carb.
fat.avocado.notes: Use as fat/side only. Do not replace rice/bread with avocado.

condiment.salty.intent: Salty condiments. Optional tiny additions only.
condiment.salty.notes: Never count as primary protein even if macro_role says protein.

condiment.sweet_sauce.intent: Sweet sauces. Optional tiny additions only.
condiment.sweet_sauce.notes: Never count as carb source for macro solving.

condiment.all.notes: Optional only, excluded from core solver unless template already contains it.

classic_grilled_plate.description: Default normal plate: primary protein + classic starch + oil + optional vegetables/condiment. Quinoa intentionally excluded.

rice_plate.description: Chicken/shrimp/beef/fish with rice. Best family for chicken → shrimp/meat fast suggestions.

seafood_plate.description: Seafood with classic starch and oil.

grain_bowl.description: Health/grain bowl. Quinoa is allowed here; this prevents quinoa leaking into every normal meal.

salad_bowl.description: Protein salad bowl. Vegetables are side/base, not macro filler; add bread/rice only if calories need it.

legume_bowl.description: Vegan/vegetarian legume bowl. Legumes are the main base, not random side carbs.

snack_fruit_yogurt_nuts.description: Fruit + yogurt/protein powder + nuts style snack.

snack_tuna_bread.description: Small tuna/bread snack or light lunch.

snack_standalone.description: Standalone snack fallback when no combined snack fits.
